title: Honey Velvety Chicken Fajitas
description: Quick and spicy fajitas with chicken, honey, and velvety sauce. Serve with tortillas, onions, and bell peppers.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil and sauté onions and bell peppers until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in fajita seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add velvety sauce and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes or until heated through.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with sauce.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble fajitas by placing chicken and vegetables onto tortillas and top with cheese, if using.
